About the Role

Ready to power the backbone of Indonesia’s MSME ecosystem? As Business Lead, POS, you’ll lead the charge in embedding Point-of-Sale (POS) capabilities directly into the GoPay Merchant App (GMA), turning QRIS payment touchpoints into complete business growth engines for over 2 million Monthly Transacting Outlets (MTOs). Working at the intersection of business strategy and product innovation, you’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Acquisition teams to pinpoint merchant pain points, execute sharp Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies, and scale usage. On top of building the future of POS within GMA, you’ll also oversee our established MOKA business—driving synergies across both platforms to redefine how merchants operate and thrive.

What you will do

• Lead GMA POS Evolution: Own the end-to-end business strategy for POS inside GMA, transforming existing QRIS-heavy merchants into active, daily POS power users.
• Monitor & Optimize MOKA Operations: Keep a pulse on the established MOKA ecosystem by tracking core business metrics, identifying recurring operational issues, and partnering with product teams to prioritize solutions.
• Master Problem Statement & GTM Execution: Partner directly with Product and Research teams to identify critical merchant friction points, build robust GTM playbooks, and accelerate adoption across target segments
• Drive Data-Led Funnel Performance: Continuously analyze acquisition, activation, and retention metrics to optimize conversion funnels and maximize merchant lifetime value
• Champion Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the central business owner aligning Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and Field Sales to deliver seamless product launches and execution
• Iterate Through Real Merchant Insights: Establish feedback loops with field teams and merchant communities to rapidly translate real world insights into impactful product features

What you will need

• Minimum 6+ years of experience: Demonstrated expertise in business and product knowledge and project management, with a proven track record of driving business growth and achieving targets.
• Strong Product-Business Intuition: Track record of translating complex merchant problem statements into actionable product roadmaps and successful GTM rollouts.
• Data-Driven & Funnel-Minded: Comfortable navigating high volume transaction data, defining acquisition/retention metrics, and extracting actionable insights from product analytics. Excel and SQL proficiency is a must-have.
• Commercial & POS/Merchant Experience: Deep understanding of Indonesian MSME pain points; Prior exposure to merchant acquiring, POS platforms, or fintech solutions (e.g., MOKA, GoPay) is a strong plus.
• High-Ownership & Collaborative Mindset: Thrives in a fast-paced environment with the ability to lead cross-functional squads (Product, Ops, Marketing, Sales) through influence and clear strategy.

About the Team

Our team collective goal is to shape the convenience of managing money on our journey to provide financial inclusion for all businesses in Indonesia that resonates with trust and reliability. This role will be part of the MSME team within GoTo Financial. We're a group with diverse skill sets, but we're united in our passion for developing innovative business strategies that drive real results. From crafting business solutions to analysing merchant data, we're always up for a challenge and constantly pushing ourselves to learn and grow.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
